item.title: Steam Deck sells out in North America within 24 hours of price hike
item.description:
📝 Valve’s Steam Deck store page notes that the handheld “may be out-of-stock intermittently in some regions due to memory and storage shortages. ” But that warning first appeared on the store site back in February, and stock-tracking websites show there have only been exceedingly brief availability windows for Steam Deck purchases between then and now. Kyle Orland Senior Gaming Editor Kyle Orland Senior Gaming Editor Kyle Orland has been the Senior Gaming Editor at Ars Technica since 2012, writing primarily about the business, tech, and culture behind video games.
🔗 Read more: https://arstechnica.com/gaming/2026/05/despite-price-hike-steam-deck-is-already-sold-out-in-north-america/
